new_destinations.name: Nantong
new_destinations.coordinates_source: candidates.json osm:park 文峰公园 (Wenfeng Park, in the old centre); re-resolve from OSM place=city
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a Nantong page with See listings (Langshan, Haohe, Safari Park); Nantong government visitor itineraries name the same places.

new_destinations.name: Yancheng
new_destinations.coordinates_source: candidates.json (Yancheng Water Street point, city centre); re-resolve from OSM place=city
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Yancheng" names the coast and birdwatching (counted source for Coastal Wetlands, Huanghai Forest Park, Salt Museum); Yancheng Coastal Wetlands and Dafeng Milu are the UNESCO/headline draws.
new_destinations.reason: Prefecture-named coast region: 6 kept spots (Yellow Sea wetlands, Milu deer, Tiaozini, Dongtai forest and old town, salt museum) with the wetlands as the draw. Considered a "Yellow Sea Wetlands" destination or standalone: the wetland places (Coastal Wetlands, Dafeng, Tiaozini, Huanghai Forest) are ~60-120 km apart, a single wetlands name overlaps the Yancheng Coastal Wetlands spot itself, and Wikivoyage groups them under Yancheng, so Yancheng is the traveller-used name. Large span because the draws lie 50-75 km out from the city; flagged for owner to reshape if preferred.

spots.name: Langshan
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: A 110 m forested hill above the Yangtze with Buddhist temples and river views, Nantong's must-see.

spots.name: Haohe River Scenic and Historic Spot
spots.coordinates_source: osm:tourist-info 濠河景区游客中心 (visitor centre point)
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: A 10 km ancient moat around central Nantong with boat trips and evening lights, a national 5A scenic area.

spots.name: Guangjiao Temple
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: Buddhist temple at the top of Langshan with a Ming-style Great Buddha Hall and the Song-dynasty Zhiyun Pagoda.

spots.name: Nantong Museum
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: Nantong's main museum, the city's history and its modern industrial pioneer Zhang Jian, named in guide and city itineraries.

spots.name: Nantong Forest Safari Park

spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.

spots.name: Wenfeng Park
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.

spots.name: Tangzha Ancient Town

spots.name: Qiaolou Tower
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: Watchtower built in 1349 in central Nantong with a Western-influenced clock tower beside it.

spots.name: Nantong Sendi Ice and Snow Park

spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.

spots.name: Zhou Ji Green Expo Garden
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: Green expo garden in Nantong, a national 4A scenic spot.

spots.name: Five Mountains
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: Riverside greenway on the Yangtze with river views and walks, at the foot of the Langshan hills.

spots.name: Nantong Eminent Figures Museum
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: Local-history museum on notable figures of Nantong.

spots.name: Chinese Ophthalmology Museum
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.
spots.bio: National ophthalmology museum in Nantong, a niche stop in the city itinerary.

spots.name: Nantong Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture Museum
spots.reason: Inside Nantong urban area, within ~11 km of the centre point and inside the 40 km span.

spots.name: Wanyuan Pagoda
spots.reason: Standalone: Hai'an is a county-level city ~55-60 km from Nantong centre, outside its bounds and span; no pin yet. Only one Hai'an place kept.
spots.bio: Pagoda at Yuantong Temple in northeast Hai'an, a national 3A scenic spot.

spots.name: Jiangsu Jianghai Museum
spots.reason: Standalone: Haimen is ~35 km east of Nantong centre, a separate district outside the 15 km reach and across the metro; within 40 km so noted: not a Nantong spot because it is outside the urban area bounds.
spots.bio: The first state-owned museum in Haimen district, covering the history of the Jianghai region.

spots.name: Yancheng Coastal Wetlands
spots.reason: Coastal reserve ~47 km NE of the city centre, within the Yancheng prefecture coast that Wikivoyage Yancheng treats as the draw; inside the 120 km span.
spots.bio: The largest coastal wetland reserve in China and part of the UNESCO Yellow Sea bird sites, known for red-crowned cranes.

spots.name: Dafeng Milu Nature Reserve
spots.reason: Dafeng district on the Yancheng coast, ~73 km south of the centre point; Yancheng coast is the unit visitors use; inside the 120 km span (90 km allowed). Pin from Wikipedia.
spots.bio: Reserve where Pere David's deer were reintroduced in 1986, with a water tower, viewing platform and golf-cart tours.

spots.name: Tiaozini Tidal Flat
spots.reason: Dongtai coast of Yancheng prefecture; coordinates unresolved, distance (~55-70 km) to be confirmed at pin resolution, standalone if it falls beyond span. Core area has restricted access: visitors reach viewing areas only, not the core mudflat. Fits the Yancheng wetlands cluster.
spots.bio: Tiaozini mudflat on the Dongtai coast, a migratory bird stopover in the Yancheng wetlands; core area access is restricted.

spots.name: Huanghai Forest Park
spots.reason: Dongtai coast, Yancheng prefecture; named in Wikivoyage Yancheng. Pin unresolved: re-verify span at pin resolution.
spots.bio: Dongtai coastal forest park (Yellow Sea Forest Park) with scenic cycling and hiking trails.

spots.name: Xixi Ancient Town
spots.reason: Dongtai town in Yancheng prefecture; pin unresolved: re-verify span at pin resolution, else standalone.
spots.bio: Ancient town in Dongtai, cradle of the county and a Buddhist holy place, a 5A scenic area.

spots.name: Yancheng China Sea Salt Museum
spots.reason: In Yancheng city itself, at the destination centre.
spots.bio: Museum on the history of salt making in Yancheng, free to enter.
spots.cost_source: candidate note: free entry (Wikivoyage Yancheng See)

neighbour_notes: Standalone within ~40 km of a proposed centre: Jiangsu Jianghai Museum (Haimen, ~35 km E of Nantong, outside the urban bounds and 15 km reach). Wanyuan Pagoda (Hai'an) is ~55-60 km. Nantong to Yancheng centres ~160 km apart, no overlap. Tiaozini restricted core area noted on the spot.
